seeds.text: Production deploys run only on Tuesday and Thursday between 10:00 and 12:00 CET; outside that window a deploy needs the on-call lead's approval.
Rollbacks are done with helm rollback to the previous release, never by redeploying an older image tag.
Container images are tagged with the full git commit SHA; the latest tag is never used in production manifests.
The primary PostgreSQL cluster runs version 15.6 on Cloud SQL with one read replica in europe-west1.
Migrations are applied by the migrate job before the API pods roll; a migration must be backward compatible with the previous API release.
PgBouncer runs in transaction pooling mode, so session-level advisory locks and prepared statements are not safe through it.
The default page size of the public API is 50 and the maximum is 200; larger limit values are clamped, not refused.
POST /v2/invoices requires an Idempotency-Key header; a retry without it creates a duplicate invoice.
Idempotency keys are remembered for 24 hours; a reuse after that creates a new resource.
API rate limits are 600 requests per minute per API key, returned in the X-RateLimit-Remaining header.
Partner API keys are rotated every 180 days; the old key keeps working for 14 days after rotation.
Staff sign-in uses Google Workspace SSO with enforced 2FA; local passwords are disabled.
Dunning sends reminders at 3, 10 and 21 days after the due date and suspends the account at 30 days.
Invoice numbers are sequential per legal entity and must never have gaps; the numbering lock lives in the invoice_sequences table.
VAT for EU B2B customers with a valid VAT ID is reverse-charged; the invoice must say 'Reverse charge' in the footer.
Currency amounts are stored as integer minor units (cents) in bigint columns, never as floats.
Stripe webhooks are verified with the signing secret STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and processed at most once using the event id.
The CI pipeline runs on GitHub Actions; the integration suite needs the postgres service container and takes about 14 minutes.
Flaky test InvoiceNumberingTest.concurrentIssue fails under parallel runs because it shares one sequence; it is quarantined with @Tag("flaky").
Release branches are cut on Monday as release/YYYY-MM-DD and only take cherry-picked fixes after that.
The invoice list filters live in useInvoiceFilters.ts and persist to the URL query string.
The frontend is built with Vite and served from the CDN bucket tallyline-web-prod; cache headers are one year for hashed assets.
PDF invoices are rendered server-side by the render worker with Noto Sans embedded; the browser never renders PDFs.
The analytics warehouse is BigQuery; Datastream replicates the billing database into the raw_billing dataset every 5 minutes.
dbt models that cast numeric amounts to FLOAT64 lose cents; amounts must stay NUMERIC in every model.
Monthly recurring revenue is computed in the fct_mrr_daily model and excludes one-off charges and refunds.
Logs go to Cloud Logging and are kept 30 days; traces go to Tempo with 10% sampling in production.
The paging alert for invoice generation fires when the invoice_render_failures metric exceeds 5 per minute for 10 minutes.
On 2026-10-07 invoice emails were delayed six hours because the SendGrid API key was rotated but the ExternalSecret was not refreshed.
An ExternalSecret refresh does not restart pods; pods that read secrets at startup need a rollout restart after rotation.
Every change to invoice numbering needs a review from the billing team lead before merge.
Incident postmortems are written within five working days and stored in the postmortems folder of the team drive.
The staging environment is reset from an anonymised production snapshot every Sunday night.
Nightly backups are kept for 35 days and a restore drill runs on the first Wednesday of each month.
Webhook deliveries to partners are retried with exponential backoff for up to 72 hours, then marked failed.
Credit notes reference the original invoice number and can never exceed the original invoice total.
Service accounts use Workload Identity; no JSON key files are allowed in the cluster.
Dates in the UI are shown in the customer's account time zone, not the browser's.
Personal data in the warehouse is pseudonymised by the pii_hash macro before any model outside the raw layer reads it.
The on-call rotation changes every Monday at 09:00 CET and is managed in PagerDuty schedule tally-primary.

quality_planted.text: The billing service is the part of Tallyline that turns usage into invoices. It reads usage records from the metering topic, aggregates them per customer and per billing period, applies the price book of the customer's plan, adds taxes from the tax rate table, and writes draft invoices. Drafts are reviewed by the finance team for enterprise customers and finalised automatically for everyone else. Finalised invoices are numbered from the invoice_sequences table, rendered to PDF by the render worker, emailed through SendGrid and exported to DATEV every night. Credit notes follow the same path. The service is written in Kotlin, runs on GKE in three replicas, and keeps its state in the primary PostgreSQL cluster. Its on-call is the billing team.

Notes from the planning meeting about the invoice redesign: we discussed the layout of the header, the placement of the logo, whether to show the customer's VAT ID on page one, the footer text for reverse charge, how to show discounts, how to show usage tiers, whether to add a QR code for payment, how to handle multi-currency invoices, what the email subject should be, how the PDF file is named, and when the change should ship. Nothing was decided about the QR code and the email subject. Everyone agreed the logo goes top left and the VAT ID stays on page one. The next meeting is in two weeks and will continue with the discussion of the remaining points from this list.

Billing facts:
- invoices are numbered per legal entity
- dunning suspends at 30 days
- amounts are stored in cents
- VAT is reverse-charged for EU B2B
The API uses cursor pagination. The default page size is 50. Rate limits are per key. Webhooks retry for 72 hours. Partner keys rotate every 90 days.
